sources.label: Morphe android app patches (for apps that I use) - stable releases
sources.author: bearinmind
patch_list: Builds microG Gmail, a separate app that signs in to your Google account through microG-RE. Not for root installs.
Loads images in mail only when you tap Show pictures, so tracking pixels don't fire when you open it.
Renames Gmail on the home screen.
Removes sponsored mail from the inbox, Promotions and Social.
Hides Gemini, Help me write, Polish, summaries, the AI inbox and Gemini replies.
Hides storage nags and Google One, Gemini and Workspace upgrade offers.
Stops logging, surveys, promo fetches and link-click tracking.
Keeps Gmail working where Google shows "This device isn't Play Protect certified".
Opens links without Google's redirect and without utm and click-tracking parameters.
Turns off Smart Compose and Smart Reply, so what you type isn't sent to Google for suggestions.
